element: Centre of the map when the position is not allowed
found: [client] The owner round 2 asks for the map to centre on the selected city when the location is denied. Neither client has a selected-city state: the app keeps a selected address (utils/selectedAddress.ts) and the web has only the saved addresses. The map therefore centres on the point of the selected (app) or default (web) saved address, and on Riyadh for a guest or a patient with no address.
suspect: Owner: decide whether a city picker (a stored city with a centre point, GET /locations/cities has names only, no coordinates) is wanted; until then the saved address is the nearest thing.

element: Providers read of the web map
found: [backend] The public read passes no lat, lng or radius_km (the backend GET /providers/map takes them and returns distance_km), so the web reads every published provider and measures the distance in the browser from the map centre. Neither client gets an open state or a price from this endpoint, so the cards draw neither.
suspect: Reviewer: once the list is large, forward lat, lng and radius_km from the page (validated numbers) and cache per area; today the full list is small.

element: Carousel swipe to map pan, and the sheet
found: [owner] A tap on a marker or a search hit selects the provider, pans the map and scrolls its card in; a swipe that rests on one card pans the map to it. The sheet with directions and booking opens from a card tap or a tap on the selected pin, not from the marker itself, so the carousel stays in view. The swipe-settle reads the viewable cards (onMomentumScrollEnd) and was checked only in a browser render, not on a device.
suspect: Owner: confirm that the marker should not open the sheet directly; device check of the swipe on iOS and Android in right-to-left.
